'''Emmanuel Ndubisi Maduagwu''' {{Audio|LL-Q33578 (ibo)-Vivian Amalachukwu-Emmanuel Ndubisi Maduagwu.wav|Listen|help=no}} (born 1947) was promoted to the rank of Professor in the department of [[biochemistry]] by the University of Ibadan in 1989 and he served the university in that capacity until December 2013.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Nigerian chemists famous people|url=https://famous-scientist.com/nigerian-chemists-famous-people/|date=2020-03-31|website=Famous Scientists|language=en-US|access-date=2020-05-24}}</ref> He was Professor of Biochemistry on contract  at [[Covenant University]]. He is a [[List of fellows of the Nigerian Academy of Science|Fellow]] of the [[Nigerian Academy of Science]] and was elected into the academy's Fellowship at its Annual General Meeting held in January 2015.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.nas.org.ng/nas-holds-public-lecture-induction-of-fellows/|title=NAS holds public lecture induction of fellows|work=nas.org.ng|accessdate=July 13, 2015|url-status=dead|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20150708065851/http://www.nas.org.ng/nas-holds-public-lecture-induction-of-fellows/|archivedate=July 8, 2015}}</ref> Professor is a Consultant in the area of food safety and food toxicology. Professor  Maduagwu is currently Professor and Head of Department of Biochemistry at Chrisland University in Abeokuta, Nigeria.

==Education==
Maduagwu attended [http://www.dmgs.donschools.com/ Dennis Memorial Grammar School, Onitsha] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231214125445/https://www.dmgs.donschools.com/ |date=2023-12-14 }}, [[Anambra State]], [[Nigeria]] where he obtained the Cambridge West African School Certificate in 1962 and the Cambridge Higher School Certificate in 1964.{{Citation needed|date=May 2020}} He received his  bachelor and doctorate degrees in biochemistry from the [[University of Ibadan]] in 1972 and 1976 respectively. He joined the department of biochemistry, college of medicine, University of Ibadan, as a lecturer grade II in 1978 and was appointed a senior lecturer in 1981.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://biochemistry.unibadan.org/staff.html|title=Staff - Department of Biochemistry, College of Medicine, University|work=University of Ibadan|accessdate=July 14, 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304213112/http://biochemistry.unibadan.org/staff.html|archive-date=March 4, 2016|url-status=dead}}</ref>
In 1989, he became a full professor of biochemistry in the same university. He retired from the services of the University of Ibadan in 2012, having attained the mandatory retirement age of 65 years.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://m.covenantuniversity.edu.ng/Profiles/Maduagwu-Emmanuel|title=Professor Emmanuel Maduagwu|work=covenantuniversity.edu.ng|accessdate=July 14, 2015|archive-date=July 14, 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150714221917/http://m.covenantuniversity.edu.ng/Profiles/Maduagwu-Emmanuel|url-status=dead}}</ref>
